cues: In a centralised system, all of it sits at one site, and every branch reaches across the network.
Easy to control and keep consistent, but every request travels, and if the server fails, everything stops.
text: Where does the database live? In a centralised system, all of it sits at one site, and every branch reaches across the network. Easy to control and keep consistent, but every request travels, and if the server fails, everything stops.
